### LiveOysterKey

```ts
type LiveOysterKey = Readonly<{
  keyId: string;
  owner: string;
  grantVersion: number;
  grants: readonly Grant<OysterKeyCapability>[];
}>;
```

The minimal live facts `OysterHost`'s `keys.live` port returns: enough to gate
one call, never the key's name or timestamps. `null` for an unknown, revoked,
expired or suspended key -- the same closed set `keyAppAccess` and
`keyAllowsComputerUse` already treat as no authority.

## Variables

### oysterKeyVocabulary

```ts
const oysterKeyVocabulary: GrantVocabulary<OysterKeyCapability>;
```

`apps.use` also reaches `apps.read` (one level, per `defineGrants`'s own
`implies`): a key that may change an App's data may also read it. `computer.use`
has no narrower capability under it; the Computer is on or off, host-wide.
`machine.enroll` admits enrollment only; it implies no App or Computer access.
The enrollment owner, not this vocabulary, owns one-use consumption.

---

### computerUseGrant

```ts
const computerUseGrant: Grant<OysterKeyCapability>;
```

The grant that turns on the Computer for a key, host-wide; there is no narrower
target.

### keyAppAccess()

```ts
function keyAppAccess(
  key,
  installationId,
): {
  level: "read" | "write";
  revision: string;
  grantedBy: string;
} | null;
```

One live key's access to one installation: `write` when its grants admit
`apps.use` there, `read` when they admit `apps.read`, otherwise `null` --
including for an installation added after the key was issued, unless the key
holds "All Apps" (`targets: {kind: "all"}`). The same shape as an Agent's stored
[AppToolPolicy](apps.md#apptoolpolicy); its caller adds `bindingName` (which
varies by caller: the plain installation id for the gate, the uppercased binding
name for MCP) to reach the full `AppToolAccess`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter        | Type                              |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `key`            | [`LiveOysterKey`](#liveoysterkey) |
| `installationId` | `string`                          |

#### Returns

\| \{ `level`: `"read"` \| `"write"`; `revision`: `string`; `grantedBy`:
`string`; \} \| `null`
